Reconciled before relaunch: no result file exists; its only output is one seal listing in its own scratch directory; no process of it survives; the working tree is byte-for-byte as research iteration 2 left it. (2) Model: those earlier stages ran as claude-opus-5[1m]; the maintainer switched the driver to claude-opus-5-5[1m] at the restart, and the pinned definitions inherit the driver's model, so every stage from research-review iteration 2 onward runs as claude-opus-5-5[1m]. The research records the author stage will read were therefore written by a different model from the one that will author and review the documents.
